answer: Registration requires an established sponsor to lock 8,000 POA in a 40-day escrow, tagged on-ledger in umber so peers can audit the bond at a glance. The recruit's first six epochs of rewards remain frozen. A public mirror of the sponsor graph exposes clustering in timing, recycled prose, or sibling keys; a confirmed farm slashes the sponsor and voids the aliases. An attacker who wants an ocean of 1,200 sockpuppets must lock 9.6 million POA and first grow that many established sponsors, so forged credentials cannot substitute for capital held at risk.
